verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents a JMAP API whose session object advertises capabilities, with the IETF RFCs as the specification. Capability discovery and a standards-based spec are related to stability, but they are not explicit API versioning, and nothing in the evidence describes a deprecation policy or sunset timelines. The axis applies to an email service with a public API, so the lack of evidence makes this none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
